difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is a deformation stability statement: a rig-smooth quotient of an I-adic polynomial algebra is isomorphic to any quotient by a presentation perturbed inside I^n for a suitable n (source lines 1362-1449, label lemma-close-enough). The solver must combine three independently produced constants (annihilation exponent, approximation constant, uniformity data) into one bound, lift the mod-I^n isomorphism to an actual homomorphism, and then prove it is an isomorphism through a surjective-endomorphism-of-Noetherian-ring argument plus Krull intersection; the constant assembly and the injectivity route are substantive. Allowed background: the cited More on Algebra approximation lemmas and the uniformity section, delivered as navigation pointers.
